title: Pending sync diagnostic omits conflicts
detail: Repeating sync on a Lane with a pending merge returns `MERGE_PENDING` without listing its conflicting paths. Include the pending sync target and conflicting paths in that diagnostic so a merge agent can resume from the receipt.

title: Task validation selects broad lifecycle suites
detail: Core finish/publication edits select 217 of 349 test files, including hosted and UI suites. Finite implementation agents need a phase-focused validation selection alongside the conservative landing selection; the broad local run competes with concurrent Lanes for check capacity and disk writes.

title: Launchd template test impact is unclassified
detail: A launchd `.plist` template selects the full test suite as an unclassified path. Finite agents forbidden from full verification must use affected backup/signer tests instead; the selector needs explicit template ownership.

title: Task validation selects broad lifecycle suites
detail: Central agent lifecycle edits produce a broad local scoped selection: predictive-overlap work selected 210 files, and a two-worker run was interrupted after 49.5 minutes with unrelated synthetic Git setup timeouts. Local task validation needs a focused selection distinct from the combined remote landing selection; it must retain coverage and report any unrun files rather than silently treating the broad selection as passed.

title: Endpoint validation selects whole backend
detail: Browser byte work touching one Convex endpoint selects the whole backend namespace and shared native parser consumers (311 test files). This scoped selection is nearly a full suite for a finite implementation Lane. Expose narrower endpoint dependencies while retaining broad combined landing validation.

title: Runner script test impact is unclassified
detail: Modal cost-model edits to `scripts/modal-check/cost.py` and analysis-worker edits to `netlify/functions/analyze-background.mts` select the full test suite as unclassified paths. Finite agents forbidden from running full verification cannot run the returned selection; the selector needs explicit mappings to the Modal bridge, cost-model and analysis-worker artifact tests.

title: Test selection compares unsynced Lane with latest main
detail: `agent tests` compares a saved Lane against the latest main. Concurrent accepted additions can appear as deletions in an unsynced Lane and force a full-suite fallback for unrelated work. Expose a pinned comparison for task-scoped validation without requiring a sync; the existing comparison remains useful for landing validation.
